lines: A vast circular chamber opens before you, dominated by a central platform suspended over a swirling void. Wind currents spiral upward in visible patterns, carrying motes of luminescent dust.

Four resonance pedestals are set into the chamber at cardinal positions, each carved with wind-current glyphs. The pedestals must be attuned in the order the wind remembers — or the currents will scatter your progress.
An inscription on the floor reads: 'Born where light first touches stone, spiraling through the high places, descending through shadow, coming to rest in the deep below.'

An inscription on the floor reads: 'Born where light first touches stone, spiraling through the high places, descending through shadow, coming to rest in the deep below.'
The eastern pedestal responds to your touch. Wind currents swirl around it, rising in a gentle spiral. The glyph of dawn glows steadily — where light first touches stone.
The wind whispers upward, toward the high places. Three pedestals remain.
The northern pedestal ignites. Wind rushes upward through carved channels, carrying motes of light to the ceiling. The glyph of ascent blazes — spiraling through the high places.
The currents shift westward, descending through shadow. Two pedestals remain.
The pedestal rejects your touch. A violent gust erupts from the void below, scattering the resonance you've built. The wind currents reset to their chaotic spiral.
The sequence is wrong. The wind remembers its path — you must follow it from the beginning.
The western pedestal awakens. Wind descends through the chamber in cooling waves, carrying the scent of deep stone. The glyph of twilight pulses — descending through shadow.
The currents pull downward now, toward the final pedestal. One remains.
The pedestal rejects your touch. A violent gust erupts from the void below, scattering the resonance you've built. The wind currents reset to their chaotic spiral.

The southern pedestal blazes with light. All four glyphs ignite in sequence — dawn, ascent, twilight, deep — and the wind barrier dissolves in a cascading wave of released energy.

The chamber transforms. The swirling void below the central platform calms to a gentle updraft. The passage to the resonance core opens with a deep, resonant tone that echoes through the entire Monument.
The Spire of Winds recognizes the ancient pattern. The way to the core is open.

actions.text: The eastern pedestal hums steadily. Its glyph of dawn already glows — this node is attuned. The wind guides you onward.
